```yaml
name: OpenData Commitment Eligibility

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    paths:
      - 'src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs/**'
      - 'src/Modules/FinOps.Recommendations/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/opendata-commitment-eligibility.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    paths:
      - 'src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs/**'
      - 'src/Modules/FinOps.Recommendations/**'
      - 'tests/**'
      - '.github/workflows/opendata-commitment-eligibility.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint PowerShell
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v5
        with:
          powershell-version: '7.4'

      - name: Install PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Force -Scope CurrentUser -SkipPublisherCheck

      - name: Run PSScriptAnalyzer
        run: |
          Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path './src' -Recurse -Verbose

  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        pwsh-version: ['7.2', '7.3', '7.4']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell ${{ matrix.pwsh-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v5
        with:
          powershell-version: ${{ matrix.pwsh-version }}

      - name: Install Pester
        run: |
          Install-Module -Name Pester -Force -SkipPublisherCheck -Scope CurrentUser

      - name: Import Modules
        run: |
          Import-Module ./src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs -Force
          Import-Module ./src/Modules/FinOps.Recommendations -Force

      - name: Run Pester Tests
        run: |
          Invoke-Pester -Path './tests' -Output Detailed -EnableExit

  integration-check:
    name: Integration Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, unit-tests]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup PowerShell
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v5
        with:
          powershell-version: '7.4'

      - name: Verify Module Structure
        run: |
          # Verify that the Recommendations app module exists and has expected structure
          if (-not (Test-Path './src/Modules/FinOps.Recommendations/FinOps.Recommendations.psd1')) {
            Write-Error "Recommendations module manifest not found"
            exit 1
          }
          
          # Verify Hubs module has recommendations support
          $hubsManifest = Import-PowerShellDataFile './src/Modules/FinOps.Hubs/FinOps.Hubs.psd1'
          if ($hubsManifest.RootModule -notlike '*FinOps.Hubs*') {
            Write-Error "Hubs module structure invalid"
            exit 1
          }

          Write-Host "Module structure verification passed"

      - name: Check Documentation
        run: |
          # Verify documentation files exist for recommendations feature
          $docPaths = @(
            './docs/features/recommendations.md',
            './docs/best-practices/recommendations.md'
          )
          
          foreach ($path in $docPaths) {
            if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
              Write-Warning "Documentation file missing: $path"
            } else {
              Write-Host "Found documentation: $path"
            }
          }
```
